run_depth2img_pipeline: run the GaudiStableDiffusionDepth2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image using HPU acceleration
prepare_depth_map: prepare a depth map from an input image using the DPT depth estimator for depth-conditioned image generation
prepare_latents: prepare initial latents from an input image by encoding through the VAE and adding noise at a given timestep
capture_replay_hpu_graph: capture and replay an HPU graph for the UNet forward pass to accelerate inference on Habana processors
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve and configure timesteps from a diffusion scheduler for a given number of inference steps
